subject: Context scenario matrix + capacity planning sync
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cloudvault.com>, Tom Rios <tom.rios@cloudvault.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Context scenario matrix + capacity planning sync

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. As discussed, we want to land on a small, prioritized model shortlist and a realistic token-volume profile so CS and engineering can size Dedicated capacity and finalize the implementation plan. I attached a simple context-scenario matrix (context-scenarios.xlsx) and a short sample prompt set (sample-prompts.txt).

High-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm peak concurrent requests and expected 99th latency requirement (target 400ms for completion).
- Confirm the longest context window needed for the assistant (examples in the XLSX).
- Share an initial monthly token estimate by traffic bucket (search, summarize, chat).

Proposed shortlist based on your feature list and latency goals:
1) Llama3-8B-q4_fast — strong cost/latency balance for short chat tasks.
2) Mistral-Instruct-7B — good instruction-following and lower token cost for summarization.
3) RedFall-13B (fp16) — fallback for long-context summarization and higher-quality extracts.

If you can reply with the three data points above (peak concurrent, longest context length, monthly token split) we’ll produce a sizing note with throughput targets and recommended model routing policy.

- Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: context-scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
Attachment: sample-prompts.txt (text, 3KB)
Attachment: redwood-onboard-checklist.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cloudvault.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:05:14 -0400
Subject: Re: Context scenario matrix + capacity planning sync

Thanks Monica — quick answers inline:

- Peak concurrent requests: 85 concurrent users during business hours, we expect up to 150 concurrent during internal peak events (training/ingestion windows).
- 99th latency target: < 600ms acceptable initially; ideally < 400ms in production after tuning.
- Longest context window: up to 8k tokens for multi-document summarization workflows, but most chat is 1–2k tokens.
- Monthly token split (rough estimate):
  - Chat interactions: 45% (~450M tokens/month)
  - Summarization (long): 35% (~350M tokens/month)
  - Lightweight lookup / rerank: 20% (~200M tokens/month)

We attached a short CSV export of typical prompt traces for reference.

Olivia
Head of Product Integrations
CloudVault Inc.

-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cloudvault.com>, Tom Rios <tom.rios@cloudvault.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 08:34:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Context scenario matrix + capacity planning sync

Folks — thanks for the numbers, Olivia. Quick internal notes and clarifying Qs: 

- Peak concurrency: if CloudVault expects 150 peak concurrent we should plan headroom for 200 for autoscaling and burst.
- Context: 8k tokens for the long path means we need to consider both memory KV cache sizing and GPU selection; Mistral-7B and Llama3-8B are great for 1–2k but will need multi-GPU sequence handling for 8k on larger models.
- Token volume: ~1B tokens/month total — that maps to ~1.4M requests if average response ~700 tokens.

I’ll run a quick qps-to-gpu mapping and get back with two capacity options: cost-optimized (more q4 quantized endpoints) and quality-optimized (fp16 RedFall nodes for long-context). Priyom — can you check quantization profile availability for RedFall-13B in our Dedicated offering?

Ben
Solutions Architect

-----Original Message-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context scenario matrix + capacity planning sync

Quick update after checking infra and model registry: 

- RedFall-13B: fp16 available for Dedicated pools, performance testing shows ~30% higher latency at 8k context vs 2k on a single A100 80GB. We can enable sharded KV and multi-GPU inference; need to budget additional GPUs per shard.
- Llama3-8B-q4_fast: available and recommended as primary route for chat and lookup. Good throughput; quantized path reduces cost by ~45% vs fp16.
- Mistral-Instruct-7B: solid medium for summarization; we should run a 48-hour eval against your sample prompts to check hallucination/regression.

Action items I can take on:
- Produce a two-tier capacity proposal (cost-optimized + quality-optimized) with estimated monthly node hours and token unit cost.
- Run a 48-hour eval against the sample prompts on Mistral-7B and Llama3-8B-q4 to capture quality metrics we can tie to routing policy.

I’ll drop the sizing note and a rough cost delta by EOD Monday.

Priyom
Applied ML / Inference Optimization
